g.text: OM2W only · same 111 fresh tasks valid in all eight cells; valid failures included. All four native methods: 300 outcomes each; collection complete.
Native: 20,000 tokens / 100 decisions; BrowserCode: 12,288 / 30. Different collection dates and timing scopes; descriptive comparison. External judging excluded.
One execution: a selected BrowserCode block or native browser-command log entry; either can contain several actions. This compares harness-level command volume, not standardized actions.
Cost: native per-task all-attempt model charges, helpers and full unknown reserves; BrowserCode original proposal/selector receipts. Tables are reported separately.
